title: ChartAxisViewWindowOptions
description: The options that define a "view window" for a chart (such as the visible values in an axis).

viewWindowMin.description: The minimum numeric value to be shown in this view window. If unset, will automatically determine a minimum value that looks good for the data.

viewWindowMax.description: The maximum numeric value to be shown in this view window. If unset, will automatically determine a maximum value that looks good for the data.
